GORE & DEBRIS DENSITY

Total blood, gore and scorch marks kept on the ground. New paint pushes the oldest out (oldest dissolves instead of popping); paint never fades on a timer, so old battlefields persist. Raise it to let carnage pile up longer in extended runs; lower it if things start chugging on a weaker device.

RENDER RESOLUTION

Render the game at a lower internal resolution and upscale it to the screen. Lower settings cut GPU load for smoother long sessions on a weaker or busy graphics card (at the cost of a slightly softer image). 100% is the native look.
RENDER SCALE: 100%
Default: 100%  |  Lower = less GPU load, softer image  |  Above 100% = crisper (supersample), more GPU load

DISPLAY SCALING

Zooms the whole game for TVs and handheld screens: the world camera closes in (your character reads larger, like a native zoom) and the menus plus the match HUD (top bars, weapon/item carousels) scale with it. Launches at 4K and dials this in instead of lowering your resolution or zooming the browser — the canvas keeps rendering at full res, so nothing goes blurry. Applies live as you move the slider and saves with the rest of your settings. Lower values show more of the battlefield (at some GPU cost); higher values read better from the couch.

ⓘ FIRST BRIEFING: HOW PROGRESSION WORKS
Every run you survive earns INTEL — from clearing waves, killing Elites and Bosses, grabbing intel chips, and extracting. Intel is banked here permanently, even when you die.
Spend it below on upgrades that persist across every future run: more health, bigger mags, laser sights, grenade launchers, Operator Kits and more. Die, upgrade, drop back in stronger. Full details live in the Guide tab.

GLOBAL FIELD UPGRADES — INTEL BANK: 0

Intel is earned by completing waves and eliminating Elites. These upgrades persist between all runs.

FROZEN SOLDAT: FIELD MANUAL

Learn it in a minute, reference it in seconds. Pick a section:

BRIEFING: THREE LAWS

  • CASH dies with you. Earned from kills and cleared waves, spent between waves on guns, ammo, and deployables. Unspent cash is gone when the run ends — unless you cash out via EVAC.
  • INTEL is forever. Banked from waves, Elites, bosses, and extractions — even when you die. Spend it in the Armory on upgrades that carry into every future run.
  • NOISE gets you hunted. Gunfire, blasts, breaching, and being spotted feed the Heat director; high Heat means more enemies, faster. Quiet weapons and Cold Barrel run cooler.

HANDS: CONTROLS AT A GLANCE

  • WASD move · SHIFT sprint (stamina) · MOUSE aim · CLICK fire · WHEEL weapons.
  • Q / Z — cycle / use the LEFT rail (consumables). Z (hold) aims grenades with Launcher L2.
  • E / C — cycle / use the RIGHT rail (placeables). C (hold) chain-lays barriers with Engineer L2.
  • F interact / pick up · F (hold) drill walls into rubble — or spend rubble building it back.
  • P / ESC pause · Pad: twin-stick, RT fire, LB/RB weapons, D-pad + L3 left rail, Y/A + R3 right rail · Touch: dual sticks, tap slots to use.

RAILS: YOUR LOADOUT, LEFT AND RIGHT

LEFT RAIL — CONSUMABLES (Q cycle · Z use)
Medpack — +25 HP on the spot.
Energy Drink — +30 stamina and a 10-second surge.
Grenade — shrapnel frag. Launcher tube fires flat; hold Z with L2 to lob an aimed arc.
Trip Mine — stick it on a lane and walk away.
Oracle Spice (carry 3) — possess a hostile, turn the pack, end in a nova that converts a survivor.
RIGHT RAIL — PLACEABLES (E cycle · C use)
FPV Drone — pilot it yourself (your body goes still). Bomber upgrade drops 3 before detonating.
Barrier — instant cover. Engineer L2 + hold C chain-lays whole walls.
Auto Turret (+MK.II) — static overwatch that never sleeps.
Spot Robot (+MK.II) — gun buddy; tap interact to send it to a waypoint.
Hunter Swarm — orbiters that peel off and dive-bomb (12 active max).
Security Camera — networked eyes that publish targets for a linked net to shoot.
Eventide Anchor — time-dilation pylon. TIDE slows all, AEGIS spares allies, HORIZON slows the world while you stand inside.

MODES: PICK YOUR WAR

  • NORMAL — waves, elites, 5 bosses, shop, extract. The main event.
  • HORDE — $10k budget, Shotgun/LMG/M1A in hand, a wave-5 swarm the moment you hit READY, 2 free perks. No buildup, all contact.
  • EXTRACTION — a 7500×7500 zone with uplink and hostage objectives under a Heat director. Get loud, get hunted. Reach the dustoff.
  • FPV OPERATOR — sealed in the bunker. No rifle — only drones, turrets, and Spot on the feed.
  • CHAOS DRAFT — no shop. Draft 1 of 3 after every wave; mutated bosses at 5/10/15/20. The Black Market takes surplus cash: reroll, take-two, launder into Intel, Blood Wager, contraband slots.
  • TOGETHER & MORE — 2P couch co-op (friendly fire off all the way to hardcore), PvP duels, Sandbox, Peaceful builder. Save battlefields as custom maps; settle scores with challenge links.

FIELD: WHAT THE WAR THROWS AT YOU

  • ELITES (2.2× HP) drop cash, ammo, health — and blue Perk Cases: pause, pick 1 run-defining perk (Vampiric, Explosive, Smart Munitions…).
  • MUTATORS roll each wave (never on boss waves): BLACKOUT dark-and-deadly, SWARM flood, JUGGERNAUT elites, ADRENALINE fast clock.
  • BOSSES — INFILTRATOR (cloak), HAMMERHEAD APC (3 gunner seats), JUGGERNAUT GUNNER (armor), HOUND-9 SENTRY (drone swarm), WIDOWMAKER WALKER (mortars). Watch the telegraphs.
  • DRILL & BUILD — hold F on a wall to grind it into banked rubble; hold F in open ground to spend rubble raising fresh walls. Forts, breaches, mayhem. WALL READ: ■ red = chewable cover · ▬ cyan glass band + sill = low window, shoot OVER it · ■ amber ticks = your built walls · grey mass = solid, don't bother.
  • DATA LINK — spool fiber between deployables with the Repair Gun. The linked net shares vision and focuses fire. Set doctrines; mind the heat.
  • SCAVENGER DOG — hostile thief bot. It steals ground loot and bolts at wave-clear. Drop it on sight.
  • ABAKAN — hyperburst rifle: every pull fires two rounds at ~1100rpm with one shove after. Tap rhythm, not spray. THUMPER — hold-to-range arc-launcher: press shows the marker at max range, holding walks it in, release lobs the fused shell over cover. Tap = instant far lob. Your own splash is halved, not gone. MAULER — full-auto shotgun: hold the trigger, 7-pellet cone, hungry and loud. JUDGE — .50 hand cannon: absurd alpha between M1A and Sniper, semi latch, shoulder-mounted regret.
  • KITS, OVERCLOCKS, ESCALATIONS — 8 Armory-unlocked kits (Breacher, Ghost, Technician…) for loadout + passive + shop rebate. Clean overclocks upgrade; Corrupted ones (Overpressure, Glass Nerves, Cold Barrel) charge a price. Escalations (Bloodhound, Ironclad, Exposed) crank extraction risk for bonus Intel.

ARMORY: 20,285 REASONS TO FIGHT

  • FIELD STATS (13,545) — Kevlar, First Aid, Cardio, 7 mag feeds, Laser array, Magnetic Gear + Greedy Hands capstone (auto-loots the field on wave-clear), Offshore Account. The quiet power that stacks every run.
  • OPERATOR KITS (2,900) — Breacher, Ghost, Technician, Medic, Pathfinder, Vanguard, Heavy (350–450 each). One per player: starting loadout + passive + cash-back on a shop category.
  • GEAR UNLOCKS (2,195) — FPV / Spot / Swarm requisitions, Turret + Barrier MK.II, Combat Engineer (barrier chains), Sentinel Cam, Field Welder (Repair Gun), Overclock + Corrupted markets, Underbarrel Launcher, Mine Protocol. Locked shop gear reads UNLOCK IN ARMORY until you own it.
  • MANIPULATOR (610) — paint, Dense Matter, Mining Rig, Rampart Fabricator. Drill deeper, build meaner.
  • TOP SECRET (800) — Eventide Anchor 500, Oracle Spice 50, Rift Network 250. The weird stuff. Worth it.
  • PRESTIGE — max all 41 and the button unlocks: wipe to zero, +1 level, a fresh menu theme and rank badge.

DATA LINK: WIRE YOUR ARMY TOGETHER

  • 1. BUY — Fiber Optic Spool $600 (shop, repeatable to 6 cables; you carry 2) + Repair Gun $1,250 (25-Intel armory unlock).
  • 2. PLACE — 2+ deployables: turrets, cameras, mines. Spot dogs join over wireless RF.
  • 3. SPOOL — hold Repair-Gun fire by a healthy node, walk to another, pin. Damaged nodes weld first — spool from a healthy one.
  • 4. PROFIT — the net shares vision: cameras and dogs publish targets, turrets and the Hivemind Post shoot off it, every node gets +5%. Interact on a wired node with the Repair Gun to cycle doctrines (Standard / Focus / Overwatch).
  • 5. DEFEND — blasts, sappers, and EMP cut fiber (your own grenades too). Weld your own stumps to splice the net back together.

AFTER-ACTION: HOW INTEL PAYS

  • WAVES — each clear pays 2 + 1 per 5 waves + 4 per elite killed. Elites also carry chips ~10% of the time.
  • BOSSES — every boss drops 2 intel chips on top of the cash bounty. Crack the black box, grab the chips.
  • EXTRACTION — the rich path: uplink hacks (20–35), hostage rescue (50), completion bonus (up to 80), and every elite drops a chip.
  • EVAC — REQUEST EVAC converts all remaining cash to Intel ($100 → 1), but only if you survive the dustoff.
  • MULTIPLIERS — difficulty, night ops, and escalations scale every payout. Chaos Draft pays through the Black Market, not waves.
  • ZERO-INTEL RUNS — sandbox, peaceful, testing, starting-cash bonus, and dev-tainted runs bank nothing (banner shows it). Custom maps in normal modes pay full — builders earn.

CLASSIFIED: DEV TERMINAL

  • Unlock: Rapidly click the "FROZEN SOLDAT" title on the main menu 10 times.
  • Open: In a match, press ~ or F1 for the Developer Command Center — god mode, spawners, infinite cash, forced mutators.
